What Distinguishes Us

What Distinguishes Our Service?

  • Free DFM Consultation

    We inform the customer before printing if their design needs modification to be stronger or less costly.

  • Post-Processing Service

    You don't receive the part 'raw', but with options (sanding, painting, or assembly) to appear as a professional final product.

  • Technical Specifications Report

    We provide the customer with a document explaining the infill percentage and layer height that was used for their part.

  • Fair Pricing System

    We provide a price calculator based on (weight + printing time) to ensure cost transparency.

  • Express Printing Option

    For those with urgent project deliveries (within 24 hours).
